title: Typed-entity extractor, typed relations and entity resolution
description:
## Context
Today's graph extractors (`simple-entities`, `ner-entities` with spaCy, `dependency-relations`, co-occurrence) emit spaCy labels (PERSON, ORG, GPE) and co-occurrence or SVO edges. A publication needs entities of its own kinds (for example maker, task, technique, licence, model family, concept, platform, dataset) and typed relations (for example made_by, built_on, measured_by, replaces, successor_of, publishes). The vocabularies are per-publication data (a closed vocabulary file), never hard-coded in Biblicus.

Papyrus consumers: PPY-428252 (public knowledge base) and PPY-77bb3b (submit-a-link: after a submission, entities are extracted asynchronously and the submitter confirms or fixes them). Exploration blbs sibling story "Evaluate decision-model-based extractors" decides which backend implements this extractor; this story defines the contract and a baseline. Parent epic: blbs-d380cb.

As a publication builder, I want a typed extractor driven by a closed vocabulary, so that extracted entities and relations are limited to kinds the desk defined, each with evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
```gherkin
Feature: Typed entity and relation extraction
  Scenario: Closed vocabulary
    Given a vocabulary file listing entity kinds and relation types
    When I extract from an item's text
    Then every entity has a kind from the vocabulary
    And every relation has a type from the vocabulary and two resolved or proposed endpoints

  Scenario: Evidence
    When the extractor emits an entity or relation
    Then it includes the source span (character offsets) and the item id

  Scenario: Entity resolution by alias
    Given an accepted entity with the alias "NAME-A"
    When a text mentions "name-a" with different case or spacing
    Then the mention resolves to the existing entity key
    And no new entity is proposed

  Scenario: Proposed new entity
    When a mention matches no known entity or alias
    Then the extractor emits a proposed entity with state "proposed"
    And fuzzy merging of distinct entities never happens automatically

  Scenario: Deterministic and cached
    When the same text, vocabulary and configuration are extracted twice
    Then the second run is served from cache with identical output
```

## Notes
Runs as a job (not in a Lambda bundle). Exports to Papyrus follow the existing graph export shape (`analysis_graph.py`, generated nodes with status generated); Papyrus owns acceptance. No default model is chosen here; the evaluation story decides.
